_provenance.what: Frozen panel for TRACE-CLASS DETECTION in whole blood. Not a composition solver and not a gauge: it answers 'is there evidence of this class at all', using a score test on the commissioned class markers with inverse-variance weights from the atlas posterior SDs.
_provenance.why_weights: Inverse-variance weighting is the whole improvement. Measured 2026-09-23 on 48 mixtures: unweighted, secretory is undetectable below 5%; weighted, it is detected at 2% on all three donors. The atlas has carried these SDs since the MCMC and the chain ignored them.
_provenance.cross_talk_caveat: At the 2% limit the classes are NOT separable: a 2% cycling spike lifts the secretory statistic marginally over its threshold (0.11-0.17 against 0.09). A detection at 2% therefore says 'epithelial-like material', and naming the class requires 5%.
_provenance.thresholds_measured_on: 38 healthy Uppsala donors (GSE87571) that played no part in choosing the configuration; threshold = 95th percentile of the score test on them
_provenance.not_for: the immune gauge, the reported composition, or any tier. Those remain exactly as sealed - this panel is a side channel that adds a verdict and changes no existing number.
_provenance.expected_scale: stage1_noob_450K RAW beta - the same input the composition solver receives (cpg_conductor passes beta_dict, not the scale-mapped beta_rm). The thresholds were measured on raw betas; handing this panel MAPPED betas shifts the statistic by roughly 24 units (measured 2026-09-23: cycling t read -37.9 against -13.9 on the same specimen), which would make every specimen read 'no evidence' for the wrong reason.
_provenance.substrate_caveat: Thresholds were measured on whole blood only (38 healthy Uppsala donors) and the statistic's scale depends on the background it is measured against. On an EPIC adenoma specimen carrying 12.2 % secretory and 35.4 % cycling the same panel returned t = 0.6 and 3.8 - lower than a 5 % spike gives in blood - because the residual structure of tissue is nothing like blood and the array is a different platform. A verdict on any substrate other than whole blood is UNCALIBRATED and is reported as such.
